<subject>SWPC 501D5A Generator Damaged Aboard M/V OCEAN PIONEER</subject>
<body>
Awaiting feedback from your team regarding:  
Coordination with the adjuster on pursuing SWPC.  
Engaging an engineering consultant to challenge the underwriter’s surveyor’s findings.

A letter has been sent to the vessel owner requesting an extension for filing a lawsuit (to safeguard the underwriter’s subrogation rights).

Clarification is being sought on the policy requirement to initiate "suit" against the underwriter within one year of the incident. The broker believes this may not be necessary since the claim has been lodged and is currently active, but written confirmation will be obtained from the underwriter/adjuster.

Michael Grant will reach out to the New South Wales legal counsel representing the SWPC underwriter about joining their action against the vessel owner.

If anyone has additional input or corrections to the above, please share now so we are aligned.
</body>
